title: Lists and Maps
scenario: Lists and maps are first-class HCL values. Define a list of subnet CIDRs and a map of tags in a locals block.
constraints: Define a subnets list with two CIDR strings.
Define a tags map with Project and Environment keys.

focus.title: Complete the collections
focus.todo: Add the subnet list and the tag map.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `locals`. Add the subnet list and the tag map. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `locals`. Use this code shape: subnets; tags. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
